about: Multi-repo: the immich and microservices-demo drift tasks with each monorepo split into per-service repositories (history kept per path, refs/agent-ab/split/), the agent started in the repository its truth files are in, the others beside it. Only --with lets glia see across them.
glia_note: Each repository has its own glia graph, and glia sees across them only when you name the others: add `{with}` to a glia command (blast-radius, diff-impact, trace, flows, contract-breaks, ..).
name: multirepo
note: This system is split into separate repositories, checked out side by side: {repos}. You are in ../{start}; the others are beside it in the parent directory, and a change may need edits in any of them.
